paper_title: First Search for Axion-Like Particles in a Storage Ring Using a Polarized Deuteron Beam
notes: First storage-ring ALP search (JEDI at COSY) using polarized deuteron beam. Primary result is an upper limit on the oscillating deuteron EDM d_d ~ 1e-22 e*cm (90% CL) in the ALP mass range 4.95-5.02 neV (spin precession ~121 kHz, m_a ~ 5e-10 eV). Paper also derives axion-photon-like coupling g_adgamma and axion-wind coupling C_d/f_a, but the directly quoted new measured result is the EDM limit, hence AxionEDM. Only approximate (~1e-22 e*cm) values extractable from text; detailed Fig. 17 frequency-dependent curve not numerically available.
